tools.name: search_stocks
tools.description: Find a company in Talval's coverage by name or ticker, typo tolerant. Returns the matching tickers, so a company name resolves to the ticker the other tools take.

tools.name: get_stock_research
tools.description: Talval's valuation verdict, fair-value estimate, upside, quality/safety/value scores and latest filed results for one ticker. End-of-day snapshot with a date.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Run one of Talval's stock screens over the covered universe and return the ranked results with fair value, upside and scores.

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Put two or more tickers side by side on verdict, fair value, upside and scores.

tools.name: list_superinvestors
tools.description: The investors Talval tracks through their quarterly 13F filings — portfolio size, position count and largest holdings.

tools.name: get_superinvestor
tools.description: One tracked investor's reported holdings and quarter-on-quarter activity, by the investor's slug (the slugs are the ones list_superinvestors returns).

tools.name: stocks_of_the_week
tools.description: Talval's current weekly picks — the latest Undervalued verdict per ticker, refreshed weekly.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_stocks" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find a company in Talval's coverage by name or ticker. Typo tolerant. Use this first when you only have a company name." → after: "Find a company in Talval's coverage by name or ticker, typo tolerant. Returns the matching tickers, so a company name resolves to the ticker the other tools take."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
